FROM node:20-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY --chown=node:node . .
RUN npm ci --omit=dev
USER node
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
caption: USER node drops root for the non-root user already built into the official Node image.
Strip every Linux capability, then add back only the one capability the container actually needs.
